//model: Primary = Claude via your GitHub Copilot license (sanctioned). Verify exact slugs with `opencode models`; slugs below are best-guess as of 2026-09 and change.

github-copilot.//: Auth via device OAuth: `opencode auth login` -> GitHub Copilot. Uses your Copilot subscription; no API key. Exposes Claude + GPT + Gemini.

anthropic.//: OPTIONAL switchable fallback. `opencode auth login` -> Anthropic -> Claude Pro/Max. WARNING: Anthropic prohibits subscription use in third-party tools; may be blocked/break. Prefer a Claude API key here, or reach Claude via github-copilot above. Leave unauthenticated to disable.

//permission: OpenCode gates tools (bash/edit/webfetch), not file reads. Secret-read protection from claude/settings.json deny-list is NOT fully reproducible here — see MIGRATION.md. bash denies below are defense-in-depth only.
//plugins: Local plugins auto-load from ~/.config/opencode/plugins/ (baked at /opt/xdg-config/opencode/plugins): rtk.ts (generated by `rtk init -g --opencode` at image build) + notify.ts. No array needed for these.
//fallback: Auto-switch on rate limit is handled by the community plugin opencode-rate-limit-fallback reading rate-limit-fallback.json. If published to npm, add "plugin": ["opencode-rate-limit-fallback"]; else vendor into plugins/. See MIGRATION.md. Manual switch: Ctrl+M in TUI/web.
